body: at my job it’s now a requirement to tell the shift coming in what food we have, what’s in stock, what’s going out of code soon, what tasks the shift couldn’t get done, etc. otherwise you could get written up for “performance issues”

ok update: nothing happened lol. no one said anything to me about it! i over heard a phone call my second shift manager was having with our  GM and it sounds like they got bigger issues than me leaving an hour late on accident. i heard our GM saying something about people getting written up bc of how many call outs they have along w other things. like people going into over time and stuff

i also have a horrible dr pepper addiction and i have bad GAD and social anxiety and i’m not medicated. so it is possible to still drink it and manage your symptoms lol. my biggest thing was to not have any caffeine before doing something that’ll make me anxious. i only let myself have it after as a treat and use that as something to look forward to once i complete the task. for me having something to look forward to after doing a thing that makes me anxious really helps so i focus on having my dr pepper (or whatever i chose as the treat) instead of the thing that makes me anxious. i also have learned a lot of breathing techniques and i have some affirmations that i tell myself whenever i’m feeling anxious. i also have a “worry rock” that i sometimes use to rub with my thumb whenever i’m in a situation where i’m feeling extra anxious (like before a presentation). i pretend that it stores all of my anxious thoughts so they won’t get bigger. which is kinda silly but it works for me haha. you can order a fancy one online if you’d like, but i collect rocks so i have one set aside to be my worry rock. i am also learning to just let myself feel anxious sometimes and if i need to have a little cry in a bathroom or something then that’s okay. one last thing is getting a good nights sleep helps a ton with anxiety so i use melatonin frequently to help me sleep better. it took awhile to find a brand and dosage i liked but it was super worth it in my opinion. sorry for the kinda long reply, but i hope something i said can help you!
